Allow complete R12 live acceptance within the job budget

Increase only verify-live's total timeout from 20 to 40 minutes after the preceding production job was cancelled at 20m23 during legacy browser regression. Preserve HTTPS validation, every browser check, the 12-minute browser-step timeout, pinned runtime, image status and approved homepage V12.
